# Native Zstd Parquet fixtures

Generated by `tests/zstd-reference` from registry Parquet 56.2.1 and libzstd
1.5.7. The 22 files contain the same 2,048 rows at compression levels 1..=22:
Int64, nullable UTF-8 with Japanese text, Decimal128(38,8), and binary values.
They use dictionary encoding and four row groups. These are synthetic test data.

From the repository root:

```sh
cargo run --manifest-path apps/yydbmanager/tests/zstd-reference/Cargo.toml --release --locked
```

The independent tool also reads Pure Rust output with the original native
Zstd-backed reader, at every level and with both Parquet writer versions.
The application tests read the frozen native fixtures without network access,
external tools, or DuckDB extension auto-installation.
